DQN.notes: Deterministic policy — identical outcome every episode. Limited by right_only action space and small replay buffer (20k) due to hardware constraints.

ppo_right_only_no_shaping.description: PPO with right_only actions, no reward shaping (original training)
ppo_right_only_no_shaping.notes: Stuck at x=1127 every episode — local optimum due to restricted action space

ppo_right_only_with_shaping.description: PPO with right_only actions + shaped rewards
ppo_right_only_with_shaping.notes: Reward shaping significantly improved exploration past obstacles
